name: Logger → Replay Boot Logs
description: Sends the messages captured during boot, `WARN` and above unless `boot_log_level` or `boot_logs` say otherwise, to every log listener, such as a connected API client. Set `boot_log_buffer_size` and call the action once a client can receive logs, for example from the API's [`on_client_connected` trigger](https://esphome.io/components/api/#api-on_client_connected_trigger); the delay below gives a new API client time to subscribe to logs first:
